text:
Some of the most impressive machines I work on are 25 or 30 years old.

No cloud. No subscriptions. No software updates every Tuesday.

Just motors, sensors, control systems, and decades of doing the same job.

They're not perfect, obviously. But there's something fascinating about engineering that was built to keep working rather than constantly changing.

Sometimes I think modern software could learn a thing or two from old industrial machinery.

I say this while building yet another piece of software.
